notes: No recorded rationale exists for turning on any unused-variable, unreachable, dead-store or duplication rule. They arrived through blanket policies: everything in a plugin at error (ESLint 2023-06 #115 and V7), Biome's "all": true (2024-07) and then an explicit full list (v5), Oxlint categories (V7) and then an explicit list of every non-nursery rule (#660, 2026-04; exhaustiveness test f7025b12, 2026-07). AGENTS.md states the current policy: 'Prefer maximum strictness over parity with a tool's defaults.'

Unused-vars options: never set in any core preset of any linter, in any era. Oxlint therefore ignores `_`-prefixed variables and parameters by default while ESLint (typescript-eslint and base rule defaults: no ignore patterns, caughtErrors 'all', ignoreRestSiblings false) reports them. The divergence is acknowledged only in the opt-in gdp preset (1cdaf877, 2026-10-05), which sets argsIgnorePattern '^_' to match Oxlint; the parity script doesn't compare options Oxlint leaves at defaults, so core's divergence is unchecked.

no-duplicate-string test override: added 2026-07-05 (dfe0f015, 'Fix lint issues') with the comment 'Repeated string literals (test titles, expected values) are normal and idiomatic in test files.' No issue, PR, changeset or changelog entry. Before it, ESLint users had the rule on in tests from V7 (2025-12-28) to 2026-07-05.

Unused exports were never checked: import/no-unused-modules (2022) and import-x/no-unused-modules (V7 to 2026-07-04) were on without unusedExports/missingExports, which in import-x 4.17.1 makes the rule report nothing; it was then turned off as an ESLint 10 no-op. Neither Oxlint nor Biome has an equivalent.
Oxlint had no unreachable-code rule from V7 (2025-12-28) until 2026-07-04, because no-unreachable was nursery until then.

sonarjs dead-store and duplication rules have been on in ESLint core since V7 but on Oxlint only in the opt-in js-plugins preset since 2026-07-07 (#742); between 2026-07-04 and 2026-07-07 init added them by default.

Possible inconsistency for the report: the agent-hook exception for unused-import autofix (#483) is Biome-only (hooks.ts L144). ESLint's unused-imports/no-unused-imports autofix runs in hooks unchanged; not checked whether Oxlint's fix removes imports in hooks.
